# <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="../icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> Substrate Vertical Layer

<p class="hdue-node-type">VOP node · <code>hdue::substrate_vertical::1.3</code></p>

Layers one surface over another (Substrate vertical layering).
{ .hdue-node-summary }

It is part of an hdUE Substrate Material Builder graph, which hdUE prepares into a UE Substrate material; it does not run as a VEX or MaterialX shader.

## Inputs

Top
:   Surface on top.

Base
:   Surface underneath.

Thickness
:   Thickness of the top layer, in UE centimeters, whatever the stage's units.

## Parameters

Thickness
:   Thickness of the top layer, in UE centimeters, whatever the stage's units.

    `thickness` · Default 0.01

Parameter Blending
:   Blends both surfaces' parameters into one slab instead of evaluating both: cheaper, less accurate. Changing it recompiles the material.

    `parameter_blending` · Default off
